name: Direct MP4
description: Direct MP4 streams from VidLink and two MovieBox APIs. 1080p and 4K only. No HLS.

scrapers.name: VidLink
scrapers.description: VidLink (vidlink.pro) — direct MP4 1080p/4K with the original audio track and bundled subtitles.

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: MovieBox (mobile API) — direct MP4 movies in 1080p/4K with separate English and Hindi releases.
